verdict.rationale: Svelte's core value proposition, per its own docs and README, is writing components in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with minimal new syntax, and community testimonials corroborate an easy transition and low learning curve compared to React/Vue. Some caveats exist (no JSX, some IDE/tooling friction, community notes on rough edges) but they don't contradict the core claim that Svelte uses familiar web languages. Missing for 10: independent quantitative learning-curve studies, and resolution of noted IDE/tooling friction around Svelte's 'superset' syntax.
